summary: A day dominated by Reliance's landmark moves and retail sector shifts. Jio Platforms targets $106B IPO valuation with October 21 launch, while Diageo enters India's ready-to-drink spirits market and Nexus Select Trust gets new Blackstone-backed leadership.

bullets.text: Jio Platforms targets $106 billion valuation in IPO planned for October 21 launch.
Diageo India launches Smirnoff Ice in ready-to-drink alcohol segment, competing with Bacardi.
Siddharth Nawal from Blackstone to replace Dalip Sehgal as CEO of Nexus Select Trust.
Delhi High Court rejected Vijay Nair's plea seeking recall of 5-month-old order in excise policy case.
UN trade body projects global economic growth to slow to 2.6 percent in 2026 amid Middle East energy shocks.
